matching_rule: A record is a Turkish-name signal only when at least one given-name token and one surname token match the Turkish population name corpus after exact ASCII-normalization. This is not a determination of nationality, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, or identity.

trnames.title: Turkish name corpus with separate male, female, and surname lists
trnames.data_description: The repository states that probabilities were parsed from 49,611,709 people born between 1888 and 1991, excluding names observed fewer than 100 times.
